description: Generated code against MariaDB through database/sql: a JSON column overridden to a plain struct and to []string is written as its document through sglDriverJSON and read back through sglScanOverrideJSON, a NULL document reading as a nil pointer; a batch upsert repeating a key runs one statement per row, as on the other engines; and SELECT *, b.* and DELETE ... RETURNING * name their columns, so the methods keep working after a migration adds a column to every table.
